description: Measure the rendered timeline: gaps in the picture, offline media, rendered against expected frame count, integrated loudness (LUFS) and true peak (dBTP), plus black and silent stretches when you give their settings. With speech {min_probability}, every cut is listed with speech facts: the speech probability of the mix just before and after it (Silero VAD), whether it lands while someone is speaking, the seconds without speech each side, and, per clip edge, the transcript word it cuts through and how much of that word is lost (from the media's transcript, when it has one). Facts only, no verdicts. Short timelines answer at once; longer ones return a task or job.

black.description: Find black stretches with these settings; left out, none are looked for

picture_share.description: A frame with this share of black pixels is black

pixel_threshold.description: A pixel this dark or darker is black

silence.description: Find silent stretches in the mix with these settings; left out, none are looked for

speech.description: List every cut with speech facts (Silero VAD on the mix, and the transcript word each clip edge cuts through); left out, cuts are not listed

min_probability.description: A 32 ms frame of the mix with at least this speech probability is speech

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one
